NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 16 SUB –SECTIONS (2D) OF THE COASTCONSERVATION AND COASTAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT ACT No. 57 OF 1981
Proposed 122 Units of Residential Apartment ProjectNo .560,562/A, Pamunugama Road,Thalahena, Negombo
ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT REPORT

IT is hereby notified that the Report of Environmental Impact Assessment study on proposed 122 Units of ResidentialApartment Project at No.560, 562/A, Pamunugama Road,Thalahena,Negombo submitted by the Thalahena Beach Houses(Pvt.) Ltd, “Jetwing House”, No.46/26, Nawam Mawatha,Colombo 02 as required by the Section 16 (1) of the CoastConversation and Coastal Resource Management Act, No.57 of 1981 as amended by the Act, No.64 of 1988 and No.49 of2011 will be available for inspection by the public at the following institutions from 8.30 a.m. to 4.15 p.m. for a period of30 days from 22.08.2019.(Except weekends and public holidays).
In addition, this report with 03 languages can be used in the official web site (www.coastal.gov.lk.) of the Department ofCoast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management.
(1) Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management Department, New Secretariat building, 4th floor,Maligawatte, Colombo 10,
(2) Central Environmental Authority No. 104, “Parisara Piyasa”, Densil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Battaramulla,
(3) Condominium Management Authority, 1st Floor, National Housing Department building, Sir ChittampalamA. Gardiner Mawatha, Colombo 02,
